definition: The observation register records what has actually been collected, when another point becomes comparable, and what decision it can support. It does not calculate a composite score or automatically classify a trend.
trendReviewRule: A series becomes ready for analyst trend review only after the stated number of eligible, definition-consistent observations. The analyst must still examine source changes, periods, and counter-evidence before calling acceleration, stability, or deceleration.

tracks.title: MCP Registry breadth
tracks.comparability: Use the same public registry endpoint and count the returned server records. If registry pagination, filtering, or record definition changes, start a new series.
tracks.decisionUse: Monitor ecosystem-supply breadth after a reviewed series exists.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not infer active production use, enterprise deployment, request volume, or shareholder value capture.

tracks.title: Cloudflare AI-bot traffic direction
tracks.cadence: Weekly collection; only 30-day-separated windows count toward the review threshold
tracks.comparability: Compare the current and preceding 30-day windows returned together in the same query. The MIN0_MAX index is comparable within that request, not a raw long-run volume series across separately normalized pulls.
tracks.decisionUse: Monitor whether repeated 30-day directional readings persist.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not infer raw request volume, total autonomous activity, or a long-run index level.

tracks.title: Fastly AI fetcher mix
tracks.cadence: When Fastly repeats the same cohort and crawler/fetcher definition
tracks.comparability: Retain Fastly's own fetcher classification, customer cohort, time window, and denominator. A changed classification starts a new series.
tracks.decisionUse: Test whether action-oriented retrieval becomes a larger share of the named network sample.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not equate fetchers with autonomous agents or extrapolate the sample to all internet traffic.

tracks.title: Enterprise AI/ML transactions
tracks.cadence: When Zscaler republishes a definition-consistent report
tracks.comparability: Preserve the customer sample, report window, definition of AI/ML transaction, and comparison basis.
tracks.decisionUse: Test whether enterprise AI network activity and control needs persist in the same named sample.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not treat it as an enterprise census or as a measure of autonomous actions.

tracks.title: Claude artifact yield
tracks.cadence: When a comparably defined Economic Index release appears
tracks.comparability: Preserve the sampled product surfaces, artifact definition, sample window, and denominator.
tracks.decisionUse: Test whether AI-mediated work increasingly produces concrete outputs in the named sample.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not use it as a measure of autonomy, agents, enterprise adoption, or total inference.

tracks.title: Long-running agentic task signal
tracks.cadence: When a comparably defined Economic Index release appears
tracks.comparability: Keep the source definition and sample intact. Qualitative reports remain qualitative even after repeated observations.
tracks.decisionUse: Track whether the source continues to describe longer-running, less assistive task patterns.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not convert a qualitative pattern into a synthetic automation rate.

tracks.title: Akamai commerce AI-bot share
tracks.cadence: When Akamai repeats the commerce sample and AI-bot definition
tracks.comparability: Retain the commerce scope, network sample, traffic denominator, and source-defined AI-bot taxonomy.
tracks.decisionUse: Track whether nonhuman commerce traffic remains material in the named vertical.
tracks.doNotUse: Do not infer successful agentic commerce, beneficial activity, global traffic share, or Akamai shareholder capture.

companyCapture.title: Akamai
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether CIS commitments convert into revenue quality, agent-control monetization, and cash returns after capacity investment.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not upgrade merely because AI-related contracts or product features are announced.

companyCapture.title: Elastic
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether agent-related cloud consumption or retention improves without degrading cloud margin and cash conversion.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate Elastic Cloud growth with agent-specific demand.

companyCapture.title: Dynatrace
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether observability consumption and AI capabilities turn into durable ARR or usage after hosting and acquisition costs.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate telemetry volume or an acquisition announcement with shareholder capture.

companyCapture.title: F5
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether AI Gateway controls appear in paid adoption, attach, recurring mix, or margin.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate product relevance with commercial adoption.

companyCapture.title: Zscaler · secondary candidate
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether security-for-agents becomes paid platform adoption while organic ARR remains comparable and cash conversion holds after capacity investment.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate agent-security product relevance, acquisition-assisted ARR, or Zscaler network research with agent-specific shareholder capture.

companyCapture.title: Twilio · secondary candidate
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether agent-driven communications create paid activity with durable organic expansion, gross-margin, and cash evidence.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate an agent platform launch or broad communications growth with agent-specific revenue or incremental margin.

companyCapture.title: Fastly · secondary candidate
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether machine-heavy traffic converts into paid edge, security, compute, or observability consumption with durable retention and cash returns.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not treat Fastly network traffic research or a product launch as proof of paid agentic capture.

companyCapture.title: Okta · secondary candidate
companyCapture.decisionUse: Test whether delegated agent identity becomes paid, measurable platform demand while RPO, margin, and cash economics remain durable.
companyCapture.doNotUse: Do not equate architecture, ecosystem support, or a beta with agent-identity revenue, pricing, or attach.

marketExpectationHistory.title: Consensus and valuation history
marketExpectationHistory.missing: At least two fiscal-period-aligned, point-in-time consensus observations and a valuation history.
marketExpectationHistory.boundary: The current public deployment is limited to an attributed daily Eulerpool snapshot. It deliberately does not commit raw responses or public vendor-data history.
marketExpectationHistory.nextAction: Do not make a gap call. Add a history only after the selected provider's public-display and retention rights explicitly cover it, or replace it with a source that does.
